acceptance: Both copies of validate-submission.yml list benchbox/core/results/standard_scales.json and the validator sync check passes on develop.
A submission PR that edits the file is rejected, shown by a test or a recorded run on published-results.
Whether the published-results validator reads the file from the submission's own tree is answered and recorded.
description:
## Problem
#4463 (merged af84bc8a36; mirrored to published-results by #4478) added `benchbox/core/results/standard_scales.json` to the files mirrored to published-results; the standalone validator reads it to decide which scales are standard and so which bundles are rankable. The submission guard in `.github/workflows/validate-submission.yml` must stay byte-identical between develop and published-results, and the published-results copy changes only through a hand-opened PR there, so #4463 left the guard list unchanged. A community submission PR can therefore edit `standard_scales.json` without the guard rejecting it. If the validator reads that file from the submission's own checkout, an edited copy could make an off-list bundle rankable; a maintainer review is then the only defence.

## Change
First answer whether the published-results validator reads the file from the submission's tree. Then land a coordinated pair: add the file to the guard list on published-results (hand-opened PR) and on develop, in an order that keeps the validator sync check green.

## Decision gates
- The published-results PR is hand-opened and its merge follows the published-results process; the owner merges it unless the owner delegates.
- Do not change which scales are standard or which bundles rank.

## Verification rubric
Pass: both copies list the file; the sync check ("Submission validator stays in sync") passes on develop; a submission PR touching the file is rejected (test or recorded run).

## Guardrails
- Work in a linked worktree from `make worktree-create`; never write in the primary clone. Stage named paths only; commit as the pinned human identity with no agent attribution.
- Push only after `make pr-preflight` passes on the exact head. Never `--no-verify`, force-push, or rewrite authorship.
- Arm only with `make pr-arm`, once per head. A second attempt only when the refusal named a cause that is now fixed; a third needs the owner. `make pr-rerun` only for a job the runner cancelled or never ran, never to re-roll a failed test.
- Never post a stand-in review. Resolve a review thread only after the bot has reviewed the new head and did not raise the finding again.
- Heavy work only through `make heavy-run` or a lock-taking target. Never set `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_ADMIT=force`, `BENCHBOX_SKIP_TEST_LOCK` or `BENCHBOX_HEAVY_WATCHDOG=off`.
- Any new limit, threshold, default or user-facing label is shown to the owner before it is committed.
- Do not mark a test skip, xfail, quarantine or slow to make it pass.
- Report only what merged and what was verified, with run ids and heads.
